title: A viewer's playback settings are saved
description: jellyfin-web saves a viewer's settings by posting the whole Configuration object to POST /Users/{userId}/Configuration (legacy ApiClient.updateUserConfiguration), SDK clients post to POST /Users/Configuration, and both settings pages fill their language lists from GET /Localization/Cultures. None of the three exists: internal/api/users.go:188-193 answers fixed values. This task saves and returns the settings and changes no track choice; JS-121 and JS-041 make them act.
acceptanceCriteria: Observed first: compat/captures/user-configuration-12.4.md and .json record, from a real Jellyfin 12.4, the status and effect of both Configuration routes for a full body, a body with only SubtitleMode, a body with an unknown field, a SubtitleMode outside the enum, a body that is not JSON, another user's id as a non-administrator and as an administrator, an unknown user id and no token, with GET /Users/Me after each; and GET /Localization/Cultures (the count of entries and the three-letter codes)

After POST /Users/{userId}/Configuration with all 16 fields of UserConfiguration changed from their defaults (each of the 5 SubtitleMode values in turn), GET /Users/Me, GET /Users/{userId} and the User of the next AuthenticateByName return every one of the 16 as saved, asked of a second api process, and again after both processes restart
A body with one field, and a body with an unknown field, have the effect the capture records (merge or reset; the unknown field stored nowhere and returned nowhere)
Two users: saving one's settings leaves the other's 16 fields as they were; a new user has the defaults the capture shows for a new Jellyfin user

Each refusal answers the captured status and stores nothing: another user's id as a non-administrator, an unknown id, a malformed id, a SubtitleMode outside the enum, a body that is not JSON, a body over 64 KB, no token; an administrator naming another user writes that user's settings
GET /Localization/Cultures answers the captured list in CultureDto's shape: the same count and the same set of ThreeLetterISOLanguageName values

In real jellyfin-web (e2e): the Subtitles settings page lists more than one language; a viewer picks German and Always, saves, reloads, and both are still selected; the Playback settings page does the same for the audio language and 'Play default audio track'
PlaybackInfo's DefaultAudioStreamIndex and DefaultSubtitleStreamIndex for 3 films are the same before and after every saved setting

The requests are in test/differential/requests.yaml and any kept difference in compat/differences.yaml with a reason; the three routes are done in compat/coverage-12.4.tsv; docs/status.md says which saved settings act and which do not yet
source: Owner request 2026-11-15 (track languages); carved out of JS-033
notes: Carved out of JS-033, which keeps user management. The settings ride on the row every request reads to authenticate (users.go:51-57), so no route gains a query. jellyfin-web posts back the object it was given with fields changed, so every field of the schema must be accepted, including the lists of ids nothing acts on yet.
